[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: 📊 **Two New Updates: Enhanced Financial Transparency**
  
  We've made our financial metrics more transparent with two important updates:
  
  **PR 2: Exposed for More Clarity**
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/2
  
  **PR 182: Exposed the Two Statistics**
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/182
  
  ---
  
  **What's New on truesight.me:**
  
  You'll now see TWO different sales numbers:
  
  1️⃣ **"Past 30 Days Sales"** (Total Ecosystem Sales)
     - Shows ALL sales across our entire network
     - Includes sales from all ledgers (AGL1, AGL2, AGL3, etc.)
     - Gives you the full picture of our ecosystem's economic activity
  
  2️⃣ **"Past 30 Days DAO Revenue"** (Main Ledger Only)
     - Shows revenue from sales of inventory OWNED by the DAO
     - This is the conservative figure used to calculate our Daily Buy-Back Budget
     - Only includes funds that actually flow into the main DAO treasury
  
  **Why Two Numbers?**
  The buy-back budget must be based on funds that are actually available in the DAO treasury. While ecosystem sales show our full activity, not all that revenue flows directly to the main DAO. Some sales are managed by individual ledgers for their operations.
  
  **What Changed:**
  ✅ New stat card showing "Past 30 Days DAO Revenue"
  ✅ Clear labels explaining what each number represents
  ✅ Updated blog post explaining the difference
  ✅ Better layout (3 boxes per row for easier viewing)
  ✅ Added explanation to buy-back budget card linking to detailed blog post
  
  **Why This Matters:**
  This transparency helps you understand:
  - How much economic activity is happening across our ecosystem (total sales)
  - How much revenue the DAO actually has for buy-backs (DAO revenue)
  - Why the buy-back budget might differ from total sales
  
  Check it out at: https://truesight.me
  
  We've also updated our buy-back budget blog post to explain how DAO generates revenue through inventory sales (used for buy-backs) and management fees (boosts treasury but not used for buy-backs).
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: image.png
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/contribution_20251220223536_gary_teh_image.png
--------
